---
title: "Interactive Weather Explorer"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load and combine all yearly weather files
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

daily_weather <- map(files, \(f) {
  read_csv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE)
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(DATE),
    temp = parse_number(HourlyDryBulbTemperature),
    wind = parse_number(HourlyWindSpeed),
    precip = replace_na(parse_number(na_if(HourlyPrecipitation, "T")), 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(
    temp_avg = round(mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    temp_max = suppressWarnings(max(temp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    temp_min = suppressWarnings(min(temp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    wind_max = suppressWarnings(max(wind, na.rm = TRUE)),
    total_precip = round(sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 10-Year Weather Time-Series (2015–2024)

Use the range slider below the plot to zoom in on specific years, months, or storm events, and hover over the line to view daily temperature records.

```{r}
#| label: time-series-plot
plot_ly(
  data = daily_weather,
  x = ~date,
  y = ~temp_avg,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "#1f77b4", width = 1.2),
  name = "Average Temp (°F)",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>Date:</b> ", date, "<br>",
    "<b>Avg Temp:</b> ", temp_avg, " °F<br>",
    "<b>High:</b> ", temp_max, " °F | <b>Low:</b> ", temp_min, " °F<br>",
    "<b>Max Wind:</b> ", wind_max, " mph<br>",
    "<b>Rainfall:</b> ", total_precip, " in"
  )
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Daily Temperatures & Extremes at Tampa International (KTPA)"),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Date",
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE),
      rangeselector = list(
        buttons = list(
          list(count = 1, label = "1m", step = "month", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 6, label = "6m", step = "month", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 1, label = "1y", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 5, label = "5y", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(step = "all", label = "All")
        )
      )
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Temperature (°F)")
  )
```
